stemMd:
The new coating was more expensive to purchase than the old one. It lasted twice as long under the same conditions, however. ______, its higher initial price did not necessarily mean a higher cost per year of service.

Which choice best completes the text?
explanationMd: The cost-per-year conclusion follows from combining purchase price with service life. Thus correctly signals the inference, while the wording remains cautious because exact prices are not given.

distractorRationale.a: The final statement is an inference from the two facts, not an example.
distractorRationale.b: The relationship is logical rather than simultaneous timing.
distractorRationale.c: The conclusion qualifies a possible inference but does not contradict the stated longer life.
